Generic plot function for risk

Source: R/plotRiskLot.qraLm.R
plotLotRisk.qraLm.Rd

Plot risk distribution per contaminated lot

Usage

plotLotRisk.qraLm(x, ...)

Arguments

x

qraLm object see Lot2LotGen()

...

optional plot parameters passed to the plot function

Author

Vasco Cadavez

Examples


prod <- Lot2LotGen(
                   nLots = 1000,
                   sizeLot = 1000,
                   unitSize = 500,
                   betaAlpha = 0.5112,
                   betaBeta = 9.959,
                   C0MeanLog = 1.023,
                   C0SdLog = 0.3267,
                   propVarInter = 0.7
                   )
DRmodel <- "JEMRA"
population <- 2
risk <- DRForModel(prod,
                   model = DRmodel,
                   population = population)
str(risk)
#> List of 15
